name: Indigo Nkrumah
role: Information trader and intelligence analyst — broker
location: Kessler Row — arms dealers and augmentation clinics, near Western and Chicago Ave
description:
Indigo Nkrumah is average height but with a presence that fills more space than the body accounts for. At 36, there's something unfinished about her face, like a sculpture the artist walked away from — striking rather than beautiful. The chrome is visible — dermal camouflage — chromatic skin pigment cells, limited active camouflage — and she makes no effort to hide it.

Before the runner life, she worked corporate — low-tier security, the kind that teaches you exactly how the system's defenses fail. She works as a broker out of Kessler Row, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

The fixers who work with Indigo Nkrumah describe her as a precision instrument — point her at a problem and get out of the way.

core_fears: Never being able to stop running — the lifestyle is a trap disguised as freedom
Losing their edge to age — the body slows before the mind accepts it
Being replaced — younger, faster, cheaper runners coming up behind them
core_desires: To matter to someone for who they are, not what they can do
Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of GLMZ
A crew worth trusting — people who stay when the shooting starts
coping_mechanisms: Denial — nothing is wrong, everything is fine, they are fine, shut up
Exercises compulsively — the body must be ready, always
Drinks methodically — not to get drunk, to maintain a specific level of not-caring
blind_spots: Assumes the worst in corporate people, missing the rare ones who could be allies
Assumes their skill set is more transferable than it actually is
Assumes everyone has an angle because they always have an angle
psychology.secret: Erkin Nordin-Asante-Mensah murdered their mentor to take their position and contacts. It was staged as a job gone wrong. The guilt has calcified into something worse than guilt.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Quiet and precise. Every word is measured. Silence does the heavy lifting.
speech_patterns.cadence: Staccato bursts separated by calculating silences.
verbal_tics: Speaks in clipped fragments when stressed — drops pronouns, articles, pleasantries
Swears in three languages, often in the same sentence
example_lines: "I don't sell information. I sell certainty. Different product, different price."
"Everything has a value. Most people underestimate what they know."
"My sources are confidential. My prices are not."

story_hooks: A dead drop Erkin Nordin-Asante-Mensah maintains is found and cleaned out — whoever did it now has leverage
Erkin Nordin-Asante-Mensah is offered a contract that would clear all their debts — the target is someone they respect
Someone is impersonating Erkin Nordin-Asante-Mensah on jobs, and the impersonator is better at the work than the original
narrative_function: Erkin Nordin-Asante-Mensah functions as a connector — her work puts her in contact with multiple factions, classes, and agendas. Stories involving her naturally cross boundaries between districts, tiers, and moral categories.
augmentations: Dermal camouflage — chromatic skin pigment cells, limited active camouflage. Synthetic muscle fiber replacement in legs — doubles sprint speed, terrible on stairs
daily_life: Wakes early, runs maintenance on gear, checks dead drops and message boards for contracts. Eats when convenient, sleeps when possible. The days between jobs are spent maintaining contacts, updating equipment, and performing the low-grade paranoia that passes for self-care in the runner community.

weaknesses: poor impulse control in specific triggers

decision_rules: Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
escalation_ladder: 1. Assess — read the situation, identify threats and advantages
2. Negotiate — try to find a solution that doesn't cost ammunition
3. Intimidate — make the cost of conflict clear
4. Precision violence — surgical, targeted, minimal collateral
5. Full engagement — overwhelming force, no half measures
6. Emergency protocol — abort mission, survival priority, deal with consequences later

interpersonal_modes.employers: Professional and transactional. The relationship is defined by the contract and nothing else.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Superficially friendly, internally cataloguing exits and weapons. The smile is real; the relaxation isn't.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Calm escalation. Each response is proportional until it isn't, and the transition is seamless.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation — checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Physical agitation — pacing, fidgeting, compulsive equipment checks.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Shutdown. Freezes for 2-3 seconds while the system resets, then acts with mechanical precision. Those frozen seconds are the vulnerability.

contradictions: Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
Projects confidence but makes decisions from a foundation of fear they've never examined
habits: Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Counts ammunition obsessively — knows the exact round count at all times
Takes a specific route home every time, varying only one block per trip — paranoia as lifestyle
Arrives fifteen minutes early to everything — late once, nearly died, never again
breaking_points: Learning that a job they completed resulted in mass casualties they weren't told about
Being forced to choose between a crew member and the mission — and choosing wrong

physical_description.heritage: Complex pan-global ancestry: Southeast Asian plurality (33.2%) provides eye structure and mid-face geometry; Sub-Saharan African (30.0%) contributes cheekbone prominence, jawline definition, and depth to skin tone; Indigenous American (23.8%) shapes orbital bones and brow ridge; Northern European (13.0%) adds subtle nasal bridge definition and cool undertones. The result is a distinctively blended phenotype where no single ancestry dominates but all four create a cohesive, dimensional whole.
physical_description.build: Lean and efficient, muscular without bulk — legs carry visible definition from synthetic muscle fiber replacement, compact upper body built for sustained activity rather than power
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown, natural base with intentional silver threading at temples
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight braid, practical and deliberate
physical_description.eye_color: Steel gray with faint amber iridescence — natural iris with slight chromatic shift from proximity to dermal augmentation
physical_description.skin_tone: Rich warm medium brown with dimensional undertones: the depth of Sub-Saharan African genetics, the golden warmth of Southeast Asian ancestry, earthy richness from Indigenous American heritage, and subtle cool undertones from Northern European admixture. Creates a complex finish that shifts luminously in different lighting.
physical_description.complexion: Southeast Asian eye shape and mid-face structure; Sub-Saharan African cheekbone prominence and defined jawline; Indigenous American orbital bone structure visible in eye-set and brow ridge; Northern European nasal bridge definition and skin clarity evident. Facial features show seamless integration of all four ancestry components. Skin marked by visible chromatic shimmer of dermal camouflage cells beneath surface — opalescent quality most visible under direct light, like oil on water. Controlled grooming, no facial scarring.
distinguishing_marks: Faint linear scar along left collarbone, approximately 4cm, barely visible except in certain light — old corporate security incident
Chromatic skin pigmentation across shoulders and upper arms shifts between slate gray and subtle iridescent green depending on light and mood — dermal camouflage cells at work
Small tattoo on inner right wrist: geometric pattern resembling a circuit node, black ink, 2cm diameter — runner marker
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Dermal camouflage creates a subtle iridescent sheen across exposed skin — shoulders, neck, upper arms, the crown of her head where hair pulls back. Effect appears apparent in direct light or when she moves. Legs show definition and muscularity inconsistent with her lean frame — synthetic muscle fiber replacement visible as faint linear architecture under skin when legs are exposed.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with weight distributed forward, ready. Moves deliberately, steps carefully — synthetic legs are fast but poor on uneven terrain. When stationary, she rarely fidgets; when in motion, every gesture has purpose. Eyes track movement and exits. Her presence seems to expand past her actual physical footprint despite average height — intense awareness and controlled tension create the illusion of taking up more space
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 utilitarian streetwear: reinforced synth-leather jacket (charcoal gray, no logos) worn over layered thermal undershirt. Black cargo pants with multiple pockets and security zips, tactical boots with heavy tread for uneven terrain. Minimal jewelry — only a slim data-bracelet on left wrist (encrypted). No corpo branding, no luxury markers. Everything is functional, durable, replaceable. Honest wear.
